notes: Temporary fishing-session effects are composed in one service; producers do not edit Encounter/Tension directly.
Consumes one physical specimen and applies the mapped effect atomically.
Timed effects tick in real gameplay seconds while the session service is active.
Using a new effect in the same group replaces/refreshes that group; different groups can stack within hard caps.
Quality buffs never fabricate a size or guarantee a record/crown; they add bounded extra rolls and keep the largest candidate.
A tempest/event can apply a weather-group modifier without changing fish-consumable code.
Consumed fish is saved; temporary session modifiers are intentionally session-scoped and are not persisted yet.
